mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_announcement ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM system_announcement WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_announcement (title, content, is_active, priority) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{isActive}, #{priority})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_announcement SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_active = #{isActive}, priority = #{priority}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_ids = #{targetIds} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM carousel ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM carousel WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carousel (image_url, link_url, title, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{title}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE carousel SET image_url = #{imageUrl}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, title = #{title}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (admin_name, action, target, details, ip) VALUES (#{adminName}, #{action}, #{target}, #{details}, #{ip})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_log ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE system_config SET config_value = #{configValue} WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_announcement_read (announcement_id, user_id, is_read, read_time) VALUES (#{announcementId}, #{userId}, 1, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_announcement_read WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 1

SELECT id, title, content, is_active as isActive, priority, target_type as targetType, target_ids as targetIds, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM system_announcement WHERE is_active = 1 AND ( target_type = 'all' OR ( target_type = 'user' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, target_ids) > 0 ) ) ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT id, title, content, is_active as isActive, priority, target_type as targetType, target_ids as targetIds, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM system_announcement WHERE is_active = 1 AND target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
